mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right Generative Engine Optimization provider for my pool contractor business?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a Generative Engine Optimization provider, look for a company with proven experience in the digital marketing space and a clear understanding of the construction or home services industry. Evaluate their AI capabilities, content generation process, and reporting methods to ensure transparency and effectiveness. Request case studies or testimonials from similar businesses. A good provider should offer customized strategies, demonstrate expertise in local SEO for competitive markets, and clearly explain how they measure ROI.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a GEO provider with proven experience in digital marketing and construction, strong AI capabilities, clear reporting, and customized strategies.
